---
title: "Overall survival — model fitting"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(mice)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results")
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

- Day-0 censoring: dropped from fitting, kept in the estimand.

```{r}
#| label: fit-os-models
#| include: false

for (index in seq_len(config$imputation$m_main)) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (file.exists(model_path)) next

  completed_data <- readRDS(
    file.path(results_dir, "imputations", sprintf("imputation-%02d.rds", index))
  ) |>
    complete(1)

  expected_ecog_binary <- derive_ecog_binary(completed_data$ecog_fstcnt)
  expected_mgps <- derive_mgps(
    completed_data$albumin,
    completed_data$c_reactive_protein
  )
  stopifnot(
    "Binary ECOG is inconsistent with the completed ECOG values." = all(
      is.na(expected_ecog_binary) |
        coalesce(completed_data$ecog_binary == expected_ecog_binary, FALSE)
    ),
    "mGPS is inconsistent with the completed albumin and CRP values." = all(
      is.na(expected_mgps) |
        coalesce(completed_data$mgps == expected_mgps, FALSE)
    )
  )

  fitting_data <- completed_data |>
    mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2)) |>
    filter(survival_time_days > 0)

  fit <- stan_surv(
    formula = Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
      tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
    data = fitting_data,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    prior = normal(
      location = rep(0, 6),
      scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 5))
    ),
    prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
    prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    warmup = 1000L,
    seed = config$seeds$survival + (index - 1) * 1000
  )
  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
